sourceBaseline.source: Greenfield v1.7.8 release package (this delivery chain)

change.purpose: Operator requests: (1) after 120 stalled minutes a queue-managed run performs a full rotation to the next runnable queue slot; (2) the in-page overlay shows a quick operational overview.
change.staleRotation: STALE_SESSION_120M: park current slot (unfinished quantum preserved, unanswered turn not counted, resume previousDisposition=SESSION_UNRESPONSIVE, sourceResponseState=PROMPT_ACKNOWLEDGED_NO_COMPLETED_RESPONSE) and activate the next runnable slot in explicit order; fallback to same-GFW session rotation when no other slot is runnable or the queue is stopped.
change.overlay: GFW id, slot position, priority, interaction/quantum (+ pending quantum), local countdown to 120-minute rotation and next F5/Ctrl-F5, turn, session, activation, prompt profile, next GFW in queue, safety hold; tooltip with ids.
change.sharedPark: parkSlotAndActivateNext used by analysis park and stale rotation

carriedFrom1_7_8.purpose: Fix FULL/COMPACT prompt continuity: a reload of the same ChatGPT conversation is not a session boundary.
carriedFrom1_7_8.rootCause: Live v1.7.7 session: a 33.7-minute EIC turn triggered Greenfield's own stale-ladder F5 (tabs.reload of the same /c/ conversation) at 30 minutes; the new content documentId was treated as a session boundary, so turn 2 went out FULL (DOCUMENT_OR_CONVERSATION_CHANGED).
carriedFrom1_7_8.operatorDecision: Same conversation = COMPACT: a reload of the same ChatGPT conversation (Greenfield stale-ladder F5/Ctrl-F5 or manual F5) is not a prompt-profile boundary.
carriedFrom1_7_8.fullTriggers: mission start/restore, session rotation, queue activation, idle keepalive, new process/run/session/tab/queue slot/mission text, conversation change, ordinals 1,11,21,..., greenfieldStatusRequest=FULL_NEXT_PROMPT

carriedFrom1_7_7.purpose: Make AI-requested runtime control a validated, bounded Greenfield-owned control point: enforce EIC terminal controls (retire the logical GFW and all duplicate slots), add whitelisted SET_QUANTUM/SET_PRIORITY, publish the contract in every FULL prompt, and send COMPACT follow-up prompts inside the same conversation.
carriedFrom1_7_7.rootCause: resolveGreenfieldControl classified STOP_PROCESS/status=DONE as state DONE without controllerOverride, so a local Hjalmar CONTINUE verdict survived and the DONE commit + logical-GFW queue retirement never ran.
carriedFrom1_7_7.precedence: operator runtime control > validated Greenfield owner state > AI runtime-control request

operations.COMPLETE_MISSION: requires status=DONE or STOP_PROCESS; retires all slots of the logical savedMissionId
operations.SET_QUANTUM: integer 1..15, target slot only, effective from next quantum/activation
operations.SET_PRIORITY: LOW|NORMAL|HIGH|URGENT, not above operator ceiling, immediate non-preemptive

carriedFrom1_7_7.legacyNormalization: status=DONE / sessionAction=STOP_PROCESS -> COMPLETE_MISSION for the prompt's own target
carriedFrom1_7_7.promptProfile: FULL at every session boundary (start/restore/rotation/queue activation/reload/conversation change) and ordinals 1,11,21,...; COMPACT otherwise with dispatch-time FULL upgrade
alsoFixed: MISSION_RESTORE admitted as A2A message type
side panel sends only edited queue field
